discovery: All Item 2.02 8-K candidates in the supplied SEC submission snapshots; record every exclusion
universe: Contemporaneously evidenced US common shares on NASDAQ, NYSE or NYSE American
selection: Enumerate before reading returns; no performance-based sampling
scope: Daily regular-session previous-close-anchored labels only; intraday events quarantined
acceptance: Engineering coverage target, not evidence of predictive power
amendment_2026_09_23: minimum_eligible_events reduced from 100 to 20, minimum_unique_issuers from 25 to 15, by explicit project-owner decision. Original targets were engineering coverage goals set before the real per-event cost (solo manual chronology review) was known; the underlying purpose -- proving the pipeline handles real-world diversity, not statistical power -- doesn't require literally 100. Issuer count deliberately weighted higher relative to events (15/20 = 75%, vs the original 25/100 = 25%) to prioritize cross-sectional diversity over repeat observations of the same company. See docs/M1-READINESS-ASSESSMENT.md 'Target amendment' section for the full record. Frozen candidate membership, event window and universe scope are all unchanged by this amendment.
